PROCEDURES NOTE

Transcatheter aortic valve replacement was performed via right femoral access for severe
native aortic stenosis.

Device: Ultra RESILIA
Implant Size: 23

The valve was deployed under rapid ventricular pacing in good position with trivial
paravalvular leak on final angiography. Predischarge echocardiography showed the mean
gradient is 7 mmHg with a dimensionless valve index of 0.51.
